title: Nudge-driven verification harness for recommended batching and caching activations
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: We need a low-friction, observable verification harness that lets Optimize recommendations for batching and KV-caching be validated and applied with an operator nudge. The harness should run synthetic and sampled production traffic canaries, compute safety deltas (latency, error rate, model-quality regressions on evaluation set, cost delta), and produce a single 'nudge' decision surface for operators in Console. Goals: reduce manual vetting time, increase safe adoption rate, maintain latency SLOs and quality guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: Canary job runs against synthetic and 1% sampled production traffic for a target config and completes within defined window
Telemetry dashboard shows pre/post deltas for p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, token-per-request cost, and eval-quality score
Operator can see a ranked recommendation with risk summary and approve via a single-click 'nudge' that starts phased activation
Automated rollback triggers on threshold breaches and publishes runbook steps and incident ticket
End-to-end test coverage for canary runner, decision surface, and rollback hooks
implementation_notes: New canary-runner service (stateless) scheduling ephemeral collocated workers to replay synthetic traffic and sample live requests
Decision surface computes normalized deltas and a composite risk score; thresholds are configurable per-customer and per-model
Phased activation uses cohort assignment based on tenant weighting with exponential ramp (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) and manual 'nudge' required to proceed between stages unless autoprolong enabled
KV-cache and batching changes supported via config layers in ServingRuntime with safe feature flags and per-model pinning
Use existing rollout orchestration library but add operator nudge step in Console and a webhook to notify on approvals/rollbacks
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Internal synthetic-only canary (privileged accounts) — 1 week
Stage 1: Shadow canary on 0.5% sampled traffic with metrics gated — 2 weeks
Stage 2: Operator-nudge-enabled phased activation across low-risk tenants — 2 weeks
Stage 3: Full rollout with monitoring and automatic rollback enabled for 48h post-final-step
telemetry_and_alerts: Primary metrics: p99 latency delta > +20ms, 5xx rate delta > 0.1%, cost per token reduction target
Quality metric: eval set BLEU/ROUGE-equivalent drop > 2% or custom eval score regression
Alerting: PagerDuty for high-severity breaches, Slack ops channel for warnings, console banner for tenant-level impacts
Tracing: include request sampling context to trace regressions to specific cohort assignments
rollback_playbook: 1) Automated rollback triggers set config back to previous pinned version
2) Post-rollback: collect traces and sample logs, create incident with playbook template
3) Notify affected tenants and CS if customer_impact is high
4) Triage: decide on revert-vs-fix within 8 hours; preserve canary data for forensics
open_questions: Should the default nudge timeout be 24h or 72h before reverting to previous config?
How to represent model-quality regressions for models without an established eval set?
Do we allow tenant-scoped thresholds or only global thresholds per release?
Need legal/business guidance on notifying customers about configuration changes that affect latency/cost
